newsitem.title: ROMANIA: U.N. SESSION TOPS ROMANIAN FOREIGN MINISTRY AGENDA.
newsitem.headline: U.N. SESSION TOPS ROMANIAN FOREIGN MINISTRY AGENDA.

text.p: Foreign Minister Teodor Melescanu, head of Romania's delegation to the United Nations General Assembly session, signed nuclear test ban treaty at U.N. headquarters on Tuesday, ministry spokesman Gabriel Gafita told a news conference on Wednesday.
The ministry's news briefing agenda also included:
* Romanian Orthodox Patriarchy Palace will host ceremony on Thursday related to Japanese grant under UNESCO aegis to repair and preserve Romanian historical monuments.
* Melescanu will start three-day visit to U.S. on October 1, to hand over President Ion Iliescu's message to President Bill Clinton, expressing Romania's commitment to joining NATO.
* Melescanu will also start two-day visit to Canada on October 3. He will meet Canadian Prime Minister Jean Luc Chretien.
* Romania to host NATO workshop over October 2-5 to discuss issues related to conversion of military industry.
* Romania will be vicepresident of U.N. General Assembly's juridical commision and rapporteur for commission on social, humanitarian and cultural issues.
